locator.name: hides the frame without unloading it where the selection has no agent, and switches back

proves.facet: With stubbed replies, selecting the ghost document shows the no-role notice and hides the same iframe under an aria-hidden wrapper without changing its generation; selecting the leaf shows that retained element again.

locator.name: keeps the same frame element across the river toggle with the load count unchanged

proves.facet: With stubbed backend replies and a synthetic ready message, river/chat toggles retain the same iframe DOM element and generation while the retained wrapper changes aria-hidden. The assertions do not count actual document loads.

locator.name: switches the selection by message without loading again

proves.facet: With stubbed backend replies and a synthetic ready message, leaf/master selection emits the exact ar.open agent/workspace messages and retains the iframe element and generation. The case does not measure a live host load or draft.

1.note: The river-toggle fixture retains iframe identity and generation while toggling its hidden wrapper.

2.note: The selection fixture posts the selected agent and workspace and retains iframe identity and generation.

3.note: The agentless fixture hides the same iframe, retains generation and shows that element on return.

4.note: The not-ready burst retains generation, sends no early post and forwards only the latest selection after readiness.

5.note: No focus stays inside the hidden chat.
